subject: Newsletter mentions as company fields
body:
Your homepage says the billion-plus record database is refreshed every month, and that 80% of your customers embed the Icypeas API in their own product. Your scope is person and domain records, so newsletter activity is a field you cannot fill: which publications wrote about a company, in what context, and on what date.

NewsletterFIT indexes more than 27,000 public newsletter publications and 143,000 articles, with company, people, topic, guest and sponsor extraction, each carrying the article URL and date.

If that is a field your customers would pay for, I can send 1,000 enriched domains as a sample. If your road map already covers it, telling me that is just as useful.
